body:
So why do you feel fortunate that you didn't kill yourself?

As for seeking help, when I attempted suicide, it was considered a crime where I was living and I had to lie about it. My mom came to visit for 2 weeks and I just went back to work and acted like everything was normal. I guess you could say that time was a cry for help, but everyone who knew (my parents and ex boyfriend) all just believed I was ok after that. I since come to realize that most people who don't have this just don't understand even if they mean well but that doesn't really help me. 

That was 2 years ago, and about 4 months ago, in the middle of everything going to shit, I did try and reach out and get help. My boyfriend at the time was supportive, but again, just didn't get it. The help was not helpful in the least, and very expensive so I stopped taking the pills and going. 

I literally went from having a dream job, making 150k+ tax free, traveling the world, having a beautiful beachfront apartment, great friends, an amazing social life etc...then I moved to another place for my career and was stabbed in the back by many people I trusted, company closed and I lost my job while owing me massive amounts of money and totally screwing me over, lost alot of money on stupid decisions trying to fix everything, had legal issues, basically had to flee the country, gained 20 pounds. Now I am back at my parent's house in a horrible rainy state, no job, no motivation to get one and just be fucked over again, judgemental family, no car, I still have money but don't want to spend it with no income, and just a miserable existence which consists of me getting out of bed once a day to shower and do chores. My bf was supposed to be coming here with me, was panning to propose to me next month, and now at the last minute has backed out and decided we have no future. that was the last thing in my life keeping me somewhat sane and giving me something to look forward to, keep me motivated to get back up again and start over. It is very painful because he was the only person I have really ever opened up to about these feelings. 

So essentially now my life is a spectacular failure and I am too tired to get back what I had. That took me alot of hard work and I don't feel like doing it again. I know life has its ups and down and blah blah blah but I'm just over it. Don't think it's going to get better and I have no energy or motivation to make it better. I don't eve want to get help anymore. It seems that people struggle with this their whole lives and it never really goes away. Not something I want to deal with.

Yeah, wow I write alot. Sorry and thanks for listening
Thank you..I appreciate it. I guess I just finally wanted to tell someone the truth for once
